tax.text: She says she would cut taxes for working families.
tax.quote: I’ll cut taxes for working families, repeal harmful tariffs that raise prices

wages.text: She says she would strengthen workers’ rights and raise wages.
wages.quote: It means strengthening workers’ rights and raising wages so people can actually get ahead.

trade.text: She says she would repeal tariffs that she says raise prices.
trade.quote: repeal harmful tariffs that raise prices, build more affordable housing

debt.text: She says she would protect Medicare along with Medicaid, CHIP, and the Affordable Care Act.
debt.quote: I’ll protect Medicaid, Medicare, CHIP, and the Affordable Care Act

housing.text: She says she would build more affordable housing.
housing.quote: build more affordable housing, cap childcare costs, support eldercare

safety.text: She proposes investing in law enforcement and prevention strategies to support community safety.
safety.quote: I’ll invest in law enforcement, fire departments, and prevention strategies that strengthen safety while building trust in our communities.

immigration.text: She said Haitian residents willing to contribute to the community should be able to remain in Springfield.
immigration.quote: And so it is important for those that are willing to contribute to our society, build businesses, pay taxes, that they get to remain here.

abortion.text: She says she would defend reproductive healthcare.
abortion.quote: ban medical debt from wrecking people’s credit; invest in mental health care; and defend reproductive healthcare.

health.text: She supports working toward universal coverage and a public option, and says she would protect Medicaid, Medicare, and the Affordable Care Act.
health.quote: I believe healthcare is a right, and I will work toward Universal Coverage so families don’t have to choose between keeping a roof over their heads and affording care.

energy.text: She says she would lower energy bills by requiring large corporations to pay for data-center infrastructure.
energy.quote: lower energy bills by making big corporations—not Ohio families—pay for data center infrastructure.

voting.text: She says she would protect voting rights.
voting.quote: That’s why I’ll ban stock trading for members of Congress, end corporate PAC influence, pass term limits, protect voting rights, and shut down the revolving door

tax.text: He voted to concur in the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act.
tax.quote: Vote Question: On Motion to Concur in the Senate Amendment

wages.text: Turner voted against the Raise the Wage Act, which would have raised the federal minimum wage.
wages.quote: Vote Question: On Passage Raise the Wage Act Vote Type: Recorded Vote Status: Passed

abortion.text: His campaign says he will continue seeking to protect unborn rights.
abortion.quote: Will continue to fight to protect the rights of the unborn.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He voted for the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act in 2023 and 2025.
gender.quote: Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act

cannabis.text: He voted against House passage of the MORE Act, which would remove federal marijuana prohibitions.
cannabis.quote: Vote Question: On Passage MORE Act Vote Type: Yea-And-Nay

voting.text: Turner voted for the SAVE Act, which passed the House and would require documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote.
voting.quote: Vote Question: On Passage SAVE Act Vote Type: Yea-And-Nay Status: Passed

immigration.text: He opposes policies that promote large-scale permanent immigration and also opposes inhumane treatment of immigrants already in the country.
immigration.quote: I am not interested in an immigration policy that promotes large numbers of people permanently settling in the United States nor am I interested in a policy that inhumanely treats those that are here.

abortion.text: In a candidate questionnaire, he said abortion should be allowed under any circumstances and that the decision belongs to the woman.
abortion.quote: Under any circumstances, its a woman's body. They are allowed to do what they would like to do with their body.

energy.text: He says fossil-fuel power will remain necessary while opposing an antagonistic stance toward green energy.
energy.quote: We aren't going to get rid of fossil fuel-based power, but we can't be antagonist to green energy either.
